description: List the platform EXTENSIONS available to your organization — the org's own plus the public marketplace — so you can suggest, inspect, or install one. Each entry carries an id, label, category, short description, and its source (organization or public); public results need no hub credential, and a note tells you when the org-owned side was unavailable. Pass query with the capability the user asked for — results are relevance-ranked against it (label, category, and the vocabulary of the blueprints each extension enables) and capped to the genuine matches, so an empty list means NO extension provides that capability. Omit query to browse the whole catalog with skip/limit paging — publicTotal reports how many marketplace rows exist. Inspect a result with list_extension_surfaces / list_extension_custom_tables; install it org-wide with install_extension ONLY when your user explicitly asked for it. Read-only. Does not write files.

hubToken.description: Organization JWT fallback, only if the hub rejects your API key for this route.

query.description: The capability the user asked for, in their own words (e.g. 'loyalty points', 'age gate', 'gift card') — results are relevance-ranked and capped to genuine matches. Omit to browse the org's own plus the first public page.

name: flow_list_extensions
title: List available extensions
